$doc: Layout widths (design/ui.md). split is SPLIT_MIN_WIDTH: at or over it the list and the open task sit side by side; under it they stack. CSS media queries can't read variables, so the kit's lint allows these px values in @media and @container conditions only. box-narrow is a container width, not the window's: v1's prompt box folds its toolbar to icons under it (@container launcher).
